name: Blackfly S BFS-U3-16S2M-CS

sources.title: BFS-U3-16S2M-CS | Teledyne Vision Solutions
sources.covers: sensor, shutter, resolution, pixel size, sensor format, frame rate, ADC, interface, lens mount, power, mass, dimensions

note: A cased USB3 Vision camera with a CS-mount and no lens, so no FOV, f-number or focus is stated: the imager has no FOV and the library uses its labelled default until the user enters the chosen lens (or a calibration). Sony IMX273, mono, global shutter, 1440 x 1080, 1/2.9", pixel size "3.45" (the page gives no unit; the sensor's pixel is in micrometres). Maximum frame rate 226 fps; ADC 10-bit and 12-bit; pixel formats are not listed on the page, so the stream format is null. power_w is the stated maximum, 3 W. size_mm is the stated 29 x 29 x 30 mm (W x H x L), entered as [30, 29, 29] with L along the optical axis. Connectors: USB3 Micro-B and Hirose HR10A-7R-6PB (GPIO).
interface: USB 3.1 Gen 1 (USB3 Micro-B); USB3 Vision v1.0
